text_block_list.text: Your Santa has arrived...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Sis...!? I thought you were traveling abroad...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, surprised? Big success, Meno. I admit, I didn’t expect you to be the first to contact me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: So Meno called you? That’s a surprise in more ways than one...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I planned to show my face anyway, if I made it in time. That’s why I was “looking forward” to the event content...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Being invited feels way better. Well then Meno, let’s begin as promised...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Yes! Final event, the Christmas present distribution! Please receive one from us Santas!

text_block_list.name: Stego & Meno
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas! Merry Christmas! Here you go, Merry Christmas. Did you have fun? That’s great, Merry Christmas...

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Waaah... thank you so much! Kyah, Stego-senpai is super rare! So happy!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Khh... hahaha! Hahaha! To think you dragged that one out... bold move!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: In the end, Mamechin pulled off the biggest “beyond expectations.” For us at least, it’s a blow on the level of a giant tuna.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah... we’ve been completely outplayed. Heh... that one really is an explosive catalyst.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hey Journey. Taking a break?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. Good work with the Santa role. I honestly thought you were still traveling overseas.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: What was that photo you sent last night? “I’m in Hong Kong right now”... It was a picture I’d never seen before, so I believed it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: A secret photo. For a surprise, a fake like that is essential. It was Meno’s idea.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe... is that so.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah, truly... a surprise beyond expectations. As expected of Meno, she strikes from unexpected angles.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So how was it, Sis? Just as you hoped... no, did it turn out even better?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Of course! Everyone looks great and is having a blast. I think choosing you all to run this was the right call.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: How about you, Journey? Did you enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Naturally. I’m very satisfied. Above all, seeing the kids...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: All gathered like this, having fun... that’s good.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Yeah... that’s great. Worth pushing for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (System Monologue)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ehh-ho, ehh-ho, ehh-ho...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Let’s finish the party with three cheers~~♪ ...Not happening on my watch!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The real final stage starts now! No, the party time starts now!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Why now!? It’s already late, it’s time to wrap up!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah right! There’s another souvenir. Glad this one made it in time too. Hey Golshi, let’s go. Ready—set!

text_block_list.name: Golshi & Stego
text_block_list.text: “Reindeer Spring Float! With a Marimo Tree Attached!”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: So!! It’s time for the after-party!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh!? After-party— I was not informed, Golshi-san!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: C’mon listen. This is my masterpiece. Took me 200 million years of secret development!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The reindeer wobbles on springs! Then the float goes wasshoi! And the seat has an electric rotation system!!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Golshi insisted she wanted a cute tree on it, so I made one with marimo goods from Lake Akan.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I don’t understand anything anymore!! What is this bizarre contraption!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Alright Meno. You worked the hardest today, so you get the first ride.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alright, hop on Mamechin! Get on, get on! Lift her up!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Okay okay, let’s shake it real good. Have fun, Meno.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hm. What’s this? A remote?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ah that’s for the rotation system. Press this switch and—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, fascinating. Then let’s spin it to the limit— hm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (BOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: U waaah aaa a a a a

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oooh she flew she flew. Alright alright, Mamechin ca— whoops!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Oh. A complete disaster. I kinda expected that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!! Nice catch, Golshi!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, hahahaha!! Excellent riding skill, Meno! Beyond expectations!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hehe... yes, truly. It was indeed “beyond expectations.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gahhhhh!! It always ends like this with these people...!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: You all better straighten up right now!!
